id.description:
Strong-typed identifier of a user account. Entity ids are UUIDv7
(Guid Guid.CreateVersion7()): time-ordered, stored as Postgres
`uuid`, exposed to the API as strings. Lives in the Identity module
(not Shared.Kernel) — other modules learn about users through contracts.

items.description: Read model of a user account — no secrets ride along.

description:
Paged envelope shared by the identity-admin list endpoints
(issue #45 / F13 — `GET /api/v1/users`, `/api/v1/grants`,
`/api/v1/keys`). Wire shape `{ items, total }`: `items` is
the already-projected view list for the requested page; `total` is
the count across every page, not the page size.
